goal: Greet the interviewer politely and tell them who you are in three short sentences.

phrases.text: Good morning. It is nice to meet you.

meaning.roman: Subah bakhair. Aap se mil kar khushi hui.

phrases.example: Good morning, madam. It is nice to meet you.
I am good at working with people.

roleplay.tutor_line: Good morning. Please come in and have a seat.

task.roman: Interviewer ko salam karein aur unse milne ki khushi ka izhaar karein.

roleplay.model_answer: Good morning. It is nice to meet you. Thank you for seeing me.

roleplay.tutor_line: Please tell me your name and where you are from.
roleplay.model_answer: My name is Ayesha Khan. I am from Lahore.

roleplay.tutor_line: Now, tell me a little about yourself.

task.roman: Apne baare mein teen chhote jumle bolein: naam, shehr aur ek khubi.

roleplay.model_answer: My name is Ayesha Khan and I am from Lahore. I have just finished my degree. I am good at working with people.

task.roman: Apni ek khubi batayein aur ek chhoti misaal dein.

roleplay.model_answer: I am good at learning new things quickly. At university, I learned a new computer program in one week.

roleplay.tutor_line: Thank you for coming. It was nice to meet you.

task.roman: Shukriya ada karein aur khushi se rukhsat hon.

roleplay.model_answer: Thank you for your time. It was nice to meet you too.

review_notes: The examples say 'madam'. Keep it, drop it, or use 'sir' as well? Check it matches how interviews really start in your market.
